question: Under what condition should a teacher grant the teaching for lasting benefit?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
This examination should be done always with care
Only then should the gift be given
inference: After thorough examination, the teacher may give what brings long-lasting benefit.
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam may refer literally to long life or metaphorically to enduring spiritual vitality.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give it so that he may have long life.
